paraphrase: For any typed history and admitted truth-vector, determining the complete supplied history among accessible worlds is equivalent to existence of an evidence-only candidate satisfying the entailing discriminator. An accessible different history with the same whole vector defeats every such candidate, including arbitrary infinitary recombinations. Composed controls retain existing all-on/off transmission, a unique beginningless Int signal under an independent gate law, a source-free copying graph, identical selection failures and internal-marker successes for source-free and rooted presence histories, and the existing source-plus-infinite-branch model. These are conditional informational constraints and stipulated models, not metaphysical adequacy or actuality.
